## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `SetupGuide`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `aws-redshift-setup-guide`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **SetupGuide**.

## Step 2: Log in to the AWS Console

1. <!-- manual: Access the [AWS Management Console](https://console.aws.amazon.com/). -->

## Step 3: Navigate to Amazon Redshift and create a cluster

1. <!-- manual: In the AWS Management Console, search for Redshift in the services search bar and select it. -->
2. Select **Create cluster** to start creating a new cluster.

## Step 4: Configure cluster settings

1. <!-- manual: Configure the cluster identifier, database name, and credentials. -->
2. <!-- manual: Configure security groups to control inbound and outbound traffic to your Redshift cluster. -->
3. <!-- manual: Record the username and password you set during cluster configuration — you will need them to authenticate. -->
4. Review your settings and select **Create cluster**.
5. <!-- manual: Review your settings -->
